facts: FY2026 revenue JPY0.45m, operating loss JPY348.873m, capex JPY121.912m, total assets JPY375.475m and debt JPY83m are statutory document observations
SBIR Phase 3 cap about JPY1.5bn, NEDO DTSU cap JPY300m and SusHi Tech cap JPY200m are awards/program limits, not unrestricted cash
bench plant completion, TYK validation, multiple customer candidates and joint-development/finance interest are observed
signed J-KISS document has a 120-warrant versus JPY100m total-text inconsistency; the cash event is counted once at the independently observed JPY100m closing receipt

A single canonical governance thread records recurring board-approved monthly SBIR bridge borrowing in 2025-11, 2025-12, 2026-02, 2026-03 and 2026-04; this is financing continuity evidence, not five separate value uplifts
JFC JPY80m loan completion is documented in the 2026-05-20 meeting record, replacing the prior single-inflow uncertainty
A 2026-07-13 closing report confirms that JPY100m was received on 2026-07-10; it is pre-valuation opening-stock provenance, not future funding
Gogin Capital JPY50m was approved and governance documents progressed in July, but no cash-receipt evidence was found by 2026-08-12, so it remains future conditional funding
The board approval thread explicitly lists Annex 1 business report and financial statements, corroborating the Drive statutory document locator
